transcript: We're on our Shoreham project today. We've been here for two days. It's a complete rip out and reinstall of this house. We've planted well over 70 different plants here. Anything ranging from Kousa dogwoods for more upright coverage, to boxwoods, to accent planting, such as Japanese forest grasses, hydrangeas, things of that nature.
